label: A concrete ground at any admitted world is a distinct CAUSE_2 of its esse
paraphrase: Open bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed: at every admitted world v, if a concrete candidate a exists at v and stands to a concrete candidate b in the selected relation at v, then a is distinct from b and a is a cause of b's being in the supplied cause-of-a-perfection dictionary at esse. The dictionary takes no world argument, so support at any world makes the supporter a cause of the supported thing's being simpliciter. Strengthens the selected-world bridge from actual grounds.
